report.answer_text:
Erling Haaland holds the record for the most goals in a single Premier League season. He scored 36 goals for Manchester City in 2022–23, his first season in England.
Andy Cole (Newcastle, 1993–94) and Alan Shearer (Blackburn, 1994–95) each scored 34 goals. The league had 42 games per season then, compared with 38 now.
Mohamed Salah scored 32 for Liverpool in 2017–18. That was the record for a 38-game season until Haaland broke it.
I didn't run a search, so this is from my own knowledge. A newer season could have changed it, but as far as I know the record still stands.
